classification: Empirical independent arithmetic and native API score verification, not universal WCL HPS/precision or quality certification
observations: Every selected marker score matches one exact native API amount row by report/fight/player; personal replies explicitly echo hps and top replies use the archived requested metric.
All recorded ranking durations equal the independently frozen raw fight duration.

All retained source-recipient healing plus credited absorption rates round to the saved score at six significant digits. This is empirical across this corpus; no primary universal precision specification was found.
A blanket0.005 interval is too wide for sub-1000 HPS examples: observed quanta shrink to0.001 and0.0001 here. Literal trailing decimal places do not define precision.

These cases cover Priest Holy and Druid Balance/HPS, not every class, guardian/pet contribution, control-time recipient relationship or later ruleset. Do not activate a universal ranking policy from agreement.
Sources deduplicate173 actor/fights across322 records; aliases remain traceable to immutable archive/member hashes.
